annotation.title_clean: Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 October 2011 on mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application EGF/2010/017 DK/Midtjylland Machinery from Denmark) (2011/725/EU)
annotation.title_en: Decision of the European Parliament and of the Council of 25 October 2011 on mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund (application EGF/2010/017 DK/Midtjylland Machinery from Denmark) (2011/725/EU)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 289/31
annotation.summary_en: EU decision mobilising EUR 3,944,606 from the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund to support workers made redundant in six machinery manufacturing firms in Midtjylland, Denmark. It has no AI or robotics content; "machinery" refers only to the NACE manufacturing sector.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mobilises EUR 3,944,606 from the EGF for the 2011 EU budget
Supports workers made redundant in machinery manufacturing in Midtjylland, Denmark
Application meets Article 10 of Regulation (EC) No 1927/2006
Decision to be published in the Official Journal
